intro.data: Not every backward machine is an inverse. One returns you to the start; the other shreds the data into something you can't undo. Pick the one that gets you home.
intro.alchemy: Not every backward apparatus is an inverse. One returns you to the start; the other burns the dust into slag you can't undo. Pick the one that gets you home.
intro.spellcraft: Not every backward rune is an inverse. One returns you to the start; the other scorches the glyph into ash you can't undo. Pick the one that gets you home.
intro.abstract: Not every backward morphism is an inverse. Only one returns to A; the other lands at C, a dead end. Pick the one that gets you home.

goal.data: Wire the start through Encode, then the machine that truly returns you to the original.
goal.alchemy: Wire the start through Grind, then the apparatus that truly returns you to the original.
goal.spellcraft: Wire the start through Etch, then the rune that truly returns you to the original.
goal.abstract: Wire the start through f, then the morphism that truly returns you to A.

afterSuccess.data: Shred would have stranded you at a dead end — there's no way back. Only Decode returns you to the original, so only Decode is an inverse.
afterSuccess.alchemy: Burn would have stranded you at slag — there's no way back. Only Cast returns you to the original, so only Cast is an inverse.
afterSuccess.spellcraft: Scorch would have stranded you at ash — there's no way back. Only Read returns you to the original, so only Read is an inverse.
afterSuccess.abstract: h would have stranded you at C — no way back. Only g returns you to A, so only g is an inverse.

reveal.summary: An inverse must land you back at the start. A morphism out of B that ends anywhere else cannot undo f.
notation: h ∘ f : A → C  (not an identity)
reveal.moreFormal: The app checks the route is well-typed and returns to A; it trusts the author that g is the genuine inverse rather than running values to prove it.
reveal.programmerAnalogy: decode(encode(x)) === x, but shred(encode(x)) loses information.
